Namqic attended [[Varivuz High School]], obtained an Honours degree in Politics, Philosophy and Economics from [[IUV]], and a Masters in Finance specializing in Economic Policy from the [[University of Vurahi]].


Namqic served in the [[National Assembly of Areoix Lie]] for more than a decade from 1748 until1758. He held multiple positions in the [[DAEL]]'s Shadow Cabinet in the National Assembly.

He served as the Shadow Deputy Minister of Public Service from 1748 to 1751 as the Shadow Deputy Minister of Trade and Industry from 1751 to 1756, as the Shadow Minister of Trade and Industry  from 1756  until he resigned to become mayor in 1758.


In 1763, Namqic was elected unopposed as the DAEL [[deputy provincial leader in Virauzua]]

== Early life and education ==
Hill-Lewis was born in [[Kaimona]]. His family moved to [[Vurahi]] when he was a young boy. He was raised by a single mother, who is a nurse. He attended [[Varivuz High School|Varivuz High Schoo]] and holds a Bachelor of Commerce degree with an honours degree in politics, philosophy and economics from the [[IUV]]. From the , [[University of Vurahi]] he obtained a master's degree in economic policy.

== Political career ==
Namqic became politically active during his high school years. During his studies at the [[IUV]], he founded the DAEL Students’ Organization ([[DAELSO]]). He worked as Chief of Staff in the office of former [[Premier of Virauzau|Virauza Premier]] [[Helen Zille]].
